notes.title: Public Alpha is Live
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]The wait is finally over. The [b]First[/b] [b]Public Alpha [/b]of [b]STAND: Sins of the Immortals[/b] is now live. This is just the beginning and we are building what comes next side by side with our community.[/p][p]This alpha is far from the final form. There are still rough edges and things to improve. Every bit of feedback helps shape what is ahead.[/p][p]Step into the fight and leave your mark.[/p][p]• Play the demo and share your thoughts
• Wishlist to stay in the loop[/p][p]Store Page: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363460/STAND_Sins_of_the_Immortals/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363460/STAND_Sins_of_the_Immortals/[/url]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638634/d921dd200a9718fb0a5eef7ce3400fda958ab7e5.png"][/img]
Thanks for being part of this journey

The STAND Team[/p]
